components.name: Primary button
components.description: Existing canonical default variant from controls.css; CSS variables inherit the active theme.
components.css: .ds-button{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:44px;padding:10px 16px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:var(--radius,.625rem);font:700 14px/1.4 Manrope,sans-serif;text-decoration:none;text-align:center;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 160ms ease,color 160ms ease,border-color 160ms ease,box-shadow 160ms ease}.ds-button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--ring,#0866ff);outline-offset:3px}.ds-button:disabled{opacity:.55;cursor:not-allowed;pointer-events:none}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-button{transition:none}}.ds-default{background:var(--primary,#0866ff);color:var(--primary-foreground,#fff)}.ds-default:hover{background:var(--primary-hover,#0755d4)}

rules.name: The Semantic Theme Rule
rules.body: Use shared semantic roles for new UI so foregrounds, surfaces and interaction states change together across light and dark modes.

rules.name: The Tailwind First Rule
rules.body: Express new feature layout, typography, responsive behavior, hover, focus and motion directly with Tailwind utilities in TSX. Keep semantic tokens and canonical control foundations in their existing shared stylesheets; do not add feature stylesheets when utilities express the design.
